properties.description: reflow2's own design record still exercises DOCUMENTS, so it can still catch a BL-176 regression on itself (tools/self_host_uses_documents.py, run in CI). Three assertions: at least 5 document/spec artifacts carry a describing edge; at least one is attached ONLY by DOCUMENTS/SPECIFIES (the canary — without it, reverting BL-176 produces no finding here); and no artifact is attached solely by bookkeeping. Guards the RECORD rather than the code, which is the BL-199 lesson: tests/orphan_attachment.rs proves the detector behaves, this proves the repo still contains the shape that would notice it regressing.
